seasons.title: NHB model project report
seasons.quote: Seedlings are mostly transplanted in the month of July-August after commencement of monsoon

tree_spacing_m.title: NHB model project report
tree_spacing_m.quote: a spacing of 6 m. x 6 m. accommodating 120 plants/acre has been considered for the present model
tree_spacing_m.note: The page gives 4.5-6 m; the wider spacing is used.

years_to_bear.title: NHB model project report
years_to_bear.quote: Mandarins start bearing from the fourth year but substantial yield can be expected only from sixth year onwards

water_need.title: NHB model project report
water_need.quote: Irrigation is provided at an interval of 10-15 days during winter months whereas during summer months it is provided at an interval of 5-7 days
water_need.note: Every 5-15 days: read as 'medium'. Agronomist to confirm.

kc.title: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, chapter 6: Table 12, single crop coefficients (Kc)
kc.note: Citrus with no ground cover and 70% canopy.

water_l_per_sqm_day.title: TNAU crop production guide: horticultural crops (2020)
water_l_per_sqm_day.quote: Daily water requirement of various fruit crops is given below: Crops Water requirement (lit/day/plant) Mango 30-50 Banana 20-25 Citrus 22-30 Guava 22-30 Sapota 20-30 Amla 15-25 Grapes 15-25 Papaya 15-25 For the young trees which are in their pre bearing stage, 1/3rd of the recommended dose of water may be given
water_l_per_sqm_day.note: 22 litres per tree per day (lower end of the range; 'Citrus' is used for orange) over the library's 6.0 m x 6.0 m spacing = 0.611 L per m² per day; young trees get one third. Agronomist to confirm.

root_depth_cm.title: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, chapter 8: Table 22, maximum effective rooting depth
root_depth_cm.note: The lower end of FAO's range is stored (the page says the smaller values suit irrigation scheduling). 'Citrus - 70% canopy' is used for orange.

source_notes: AI research batch 7 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Sowing months for Madhya Pradesh come from the state crop-season table; other values are from TNAU/NHB (Tamil Nadu and national) until a local source is found.
